proof.text: For each point sigma, its assumed integral factorization equals the canonical residue embedding by the SpecToEquivOfField bijection, or equivalently cancellation of the mono fromSpecResidueField. For nu composed with sigma, the unique point of Spec Omega maps to the unique point of Spec k. Transport this residue embedding to the image of the composite and cancel fromSpecResidueField again to show its composite with Spec.preimage nu equals the geometric-point residue embedding.

Apply strictHenselizationResidue to s = nu composed with sigma, with the Omega algebra structure given by its canonical residue embedding. Obtain strict henselian local structure on the concrete strictHenselizationRing s, the unique residue equivalence delta with the relative separable closure E in Omega, and the geometric-point factorization.

Apply the proved upstream RingHom.exists_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.FieldTheory.IsSepClosed) to the separable extension E/F, the integral embedding b:F to k, and the embeddings k to Omega and E to Omega. This gives eta:E to k whose composite into Omega is the inclusion. Injectivity of k to Omega proves eta composed with F to E equals b. For every x in k, its integral polynomial over F is mapped to E, proving eta.IsIntegral by RingHom.IsIntegralElem.of_comp. Compose eta with delta to obtain gamma:ResidueField(strictHenselizationRing s) to k; it is integral since delta is an isomorphism. Since its source is separably closed, Mathlib infers IsPurelyInseparable, and Algebra.IsUniversalHomeomorphism.of_isPurelyInseparable makes rho = Spec.map gamma a universal homeomorphism.

The equation beta composed with gamma = inclusion composed with delta identifies nu composed with rho with the canonical geometric residue map. The strictHenselizationResidue structural equation therefore gives the required factorization after precomposition by nu. A field spectrum map is flat and surjective, hence epi by Flat.epi_of_flat_of_surjective; cancel nu. Apply this single-point proof to sigma with nu composed with iota and to tau with nu. Use the concrete colimit rings as A and B and identity spectrum isomorphisms, normalizing associativity. The compatibility hypothesis h_iota is unnecessary for these independent existence clauses.

theorem Etale.exists_compatibleStrictHenselizationCoreExistence
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S}
    {k k' Ω : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (hσ : ∃ (s : S) (ψ : S.residueField s ⟶ .of k),
      ψ.hom.IsIntegral ∧ Spec.map ψ ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s = σ)
    (hτ : ∃ (t : T) (ψ : T.residueField t ⟶ .of k'),
      ψ.hom.IsIntegral ∧ Spec.map ψ ≫ T.fromSpecResidueField t = τ)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k')) :
    let s := ν ≫ ι ≫ σ
    let t := ν ≫ τ
    ∃ (A B : Type u) (cA : CommRing A) (cB : CommRing B),
      letI := cA
      letI := cB
      ∃ (hA : HenselianLocalRing A) (hB : HenselianLocalRing B),
        letI := hA
        letI := hB
        ∃ (sA : IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
          (sB : IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)),
          letI := sA
          letI := sB
          ∃ (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
            (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme t)
            (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
            (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B))),
            IsUniversalHomeomorphism ρA ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism ρB ∧
            ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
              eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s = σ ∧
            ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
              eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap t = τ

statement: For the two geometric points induced from σ and τ in the algebraically closed Ω, the coordinate-ring strict henselizations have henselian local and separably closed residue structures, spectrum identifications, and universal-homeomorphism residue maps factoring σ and τ. No ring map between the two rings is asserted.
